scenes.title: Built By Brain
scenes.text: Color is not really out there in the world. Your brain builds it from the light that reaches your eyes.

scenes.title: Hidden Spectrum
scenes.text: White light is actually every color mixed together, which a prism can split into a rainbow in an instant.

scenes.title: Sky Trick
scenes.text: The sky is blue because air scatters blue light more than other colors, filling the daytime with that shade.

scenes.title: Color Blind
scenes.text: About eight percent of men see colors differently, and a single photo can look completely different to two people.

scenes.title: The Dress
scenes.text: A simple photo once split the internet in two, with half seeing blue and gold and half seeing white and pink.

scenes.title: More Colors
scenes.text: A mantis shrimp has far more color receptors than you, seeing a world of shades your eyes cannot imagine.

scenes.title: Names Matter
scenes.text: The words you know change the colors you notice, and learning a new color name sharpens your eye to it.

scenes.title: Your Turn
scenes.text: Color is a story your brain tells you. What is your favorite color, and do you trust what you see?
